findings.text: blocking: the head-arm after_suite log the manifest cites was rewritten after the manifest (log mtime 11:27:11 vs manifest 11:22:11) and the run ended four seconds later (exit.json 11:27:15), leaving the file truncated at 63% with no summary line and no EXIT= line, so the 562-passed/1-failed result and the gate exit status the manifest records for the head arm cannot be read from the log it names.

follow-on: the baseline_suite and after_suite records carry an angle-bracket placeholder in their command fields (`-q <29 reports-surface test files>`), which the armed-suite record contract forbids; the two logs themselves carry the literal command, so this is a recording defect rather than a missing measurement.

item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records commit b09a26b15, status complete, the gate at 5 passed, the reports-surface head/base arms, the declared negative control and ruff by delta, but its after_suite cites logs/head-arm-reports-surface.txt as completed with exit_status 1 while that file ends mid-suite, and both armed-suite records carry an angle-bracket placeholder in their command fields.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source dispatch fences reckon/crew/reports.py, reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_a_png_twin_of_an_svg_is_refused.py, the fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-can-see-the-figure/ and docs/figures/a-review-can-see-the-figure/promotion-refuses-a-png-twin-of-an-svg; the base..head diff changes exactly those first four and the fragment, all inside the fence.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_png_twin_of_an_svg_is_refused.py:167-177 asserts the exit code, the single twin finding and both paths independently of the value under test, and the declared negative control (logs/negative-control.txt) shows that removing the check reddens test_a_png_beside_its_svg_is_reported_and_refused at the removal.
justifications.evidence: The gate log records 5 passed EXIT=0 and the negative control is red as declared, but the after_suite log the manifest cites at logs/head-arm-reports-surface.txt is truncated at 63% with no EXIT= line, so the head-arm result is not readable from the artifact it names.
justifications.fit: The new helpers follow the module's existing local `_...findings` idiom in reckon/crew/reports.py and introduce no plan, sprint or version label; the commit subject names no plan identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/reports.py:2580 adds the twin findings to `audit_manifest` and reckon/crew/promotion.py:586 adds the refusal to `complete`, so both surfaces the goal names are reached through one predicate.
justifications.reuse: A capability search over reckon/ for a PNG-twin or figure-rule check and for a committed-path lister found none; the addition reuses the module's own `_citation_stores`, `_run_diff_store` and `_NONE_VALUES`, and its two small git probes match reports.py's existing local-helper style rather than forking an owned mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in `git diff --stat 5af4cf2fd..b09a26b15` (reckon/crew/reports.py, promotion.py, promotion_checks.py, the new test and the fragment) is inside the source dispatch's declared write paths, and the granted figures directory was not used.
